mapper.update: UPDATE payment_transactions SET status = #{status}, external_transaction_id = #{externalId}, provider_response = #{providerResponse}::jsonb, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE reference_id = #{referenceId}
UPDATE payment_transactions SET status = #{status}, note = #{note}, confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, external_transaction_id = #{externalTransactionId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE payment_transactions SET status = #{status}, confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, note = CONCAT(note, ' | Updated by Shipment Service') WHERE order_code = #{orderCode} AND payment_method = 'COD' AND status = 'PENDING'
